label: Households >=30 min from drinking water
notes: Round trip to the main drinking-water source takes 30 min or more (Sphere standard). Household survey, Jul-Sep each year (shown at YYYY-07). Rounds 2022-2024 only: no county-level MSNA tables exist on HDX for 2018-2021, so the baseline is 2022. Questions were reworded between rounds (e.g. 2022 groups shallow wells with rivers/ponds), so small year-to-year changes are not meaningful; county samples are ~100-300 households (margin of error ~5-10 points).
source: South Sudan Inter-Sector Needs Assessment (ISNA, the country's MSNA; REACH/IMPACT for OCHA & ICCG) 2022-2024, county tables on HDX
aggregation: weighted % of surveyed households in county (all population groups)
